en: A colorized view over a European riverside town with tightly packed multi‑story houses with red-tile roofs along a riverbank. Above the town, on a wooded hill, stands a large medieval hilltop fortress complex with multiple walls, towers, and buildings. To the right is a tall church with a distinctive Baroque onion-dome tower. The scene is surrounded by green countryside under a lightly clouded sky. No visible printed captions or text appear on the image side.
